corrections.reason: Grammatically 'like you' in Amharic is 'እንዳንተ' (1st order ተ), where the right-leg vowel loop of ተ was slightly faint and misread as 6th-order ት.
The word split across lines 9-10 is the Amharic gerundive 'ተንቈጫቍጮ' (having been dashed to pieces, he died). The 7th-order ring on ጮ is visible on the right arm of the glyph.
